simple.meaning: זָרַק (zâraq) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to sprinkle (fluid or solid particles).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 35 times in Exodus, Leviticus, Numbers, 2 Kings, 2 Chronicles, and 4 more, beginning at Exodus 9:8. The surrounding contexts include family line, altar, blood, covenant, kingship.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָרַק (H2236) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: זָרַק (zâraq) / H2236 is traced through Exodus 9:8, Exodus 9:10, Exodus 24:6, Exodus 24:8 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.usage: be here and there, scatter, sprinkle, strew.
definitions.full: H2236. zaraq זָרַק verb to toss or throw (in a volume), scatter abundantly (Late Hebrew id. ; Aramaic זְרַק id. , disperse ; Assyrian zarâ‡u Lotz TP138 Jäger BAS ii. 292 Anm. **; compare also Arabic cast at, pierce , and javelin = Ethiopic ) — Qal Perfect ׳ז Exod 24:6 ; Lev 17:6 , suffix זְרָקוֺ Exod 9:8 , זָָֽרְקָה Hosea 7:9 (12 t. Perfect); Imperfect יִזְרֹק Lev 7:2 16 t.; Infinitive לִזְרֹק Ezek 43:18 ; Imperative זְרֹק 10:2 ; Participle זֹרֵק Lev 7:14 , plural זֹרְקִים 2Chr 30:16 ; 1 toss (in handfuls, see Exod 9:8 ; or from a bowl , מִזְרָק ; opposed to הִזָּה to sprinkle with the finger): a. cummin Isa 28:25 , dust, followed by עַל 2Chr 34:4 ; Job 2:12 , ashes השׁמימה , heavenward, Exod 9:8 , 10 (P), coals of fire העיר על Ezek 10:2 . b. blood , (ה)מזבה על throw (from a bowl) against the altar Exod 24:6 (JE), Lev 17:6 (H), Num 18:17 (P), 2Kin 16:13 , 15 ; Ezek 43:18 , especially in the ritual, סביב חמזבח על against the altar round about Exod 29:16 , 20 ; Lev 1:5 , 11 ; 3:2 , 8 , 13 ; 7:2 ; 8:19 , 24 ; 9:12 , 18 (all P); followed by העם על Exod 24:8 (JE), followed by המזבחה 2Chr 29:22 (3 t. in verse); without designation of place Lev 7:14 (P), 2Chr 30:16 ; 35:11 . c. water for purification, followed by על , Ezek 36:25 . 2 intransitive (si vera lectio) Hosea 7:9 בּוֺ זָָֽרְקָה שֵׂיבָה גַּם grey hairs are profuse upon him (? read זָָֽרְחָה , as in 2Chr 26:19 ). Pu`al Perfect זֹרַק , of water of purification poured over ( עַל ) one defiled by a corpse Num 19:18 , 20 (P).
